page.title: Accounts
page.subtitle: Where the money sits — bank, cash, owner-paid, deposits — plus transfers, capital and loans

stats.cashBankSub: Per currency — never converted or added together

unclassified.title: {count, plural, one {# movement need classifying} other {# movements need classifying}}
unclassified.description: Money moved but we don't know why yet — mark it as capital, a loan, or a repayment.

account.emptyAdmin: No accounts yet. Add your first one above.

loans.title: Loans
loans.description: Money lent to the company. Outstanding = received − repaid.

movements.title: Transfers, capital & loans
movements.description: Money moving between accounts or financing the company. None of it touches profit & loss.
movements.empty: Nothing yet. Record a transfer, capital contribution or loan above.
movements.reversePrompt: Reverse this posted movement? Give the reason — then record the correct one.
movements.deleteConfirm: Delete this movement? A transfer deletes both sides.

accountDialog.openingHelp: The balance on that date. Movements dated before it are treated as already included.
accountDialog.openingHelpOwner: For an owner account: negative = the company owes the owner; positive = the owner holds company money.
accountDialog.active: Active (inactive accounts are hidden from pickers but keep their history)

transferDialog.intro: Moves money between your own accounts. It never counts as income or expense.
transferDialog.exactFigures: Use the exact figures from the bank statement.

movementDialog.financingHelp: Financing — not income or expense. It changes the account balance but never your profit.
movementDialog.noLoans: No {currency} loans — add one with “New loan”

loanDialog.title: New loan
loanDialog.help: Then record money received and repayments against it — the outstanding amount is calculated for you.

select.empty: No accounts — an admin adds them on the Accounts page

errors.locked: This is posted — reverse it from the ledger entry instead of editing.
errors.bankMatched: This is matched to a bank statement line. {problem} Unmatch it on the Bank page first.
errors.currencyLocked: This account already has movements, so its currency can't change.
errors.chooseMovementKind: Choose what kind of movement this is.
errors.invalidAmountDate: Enter a valid amount and date.
errors.chooseLoan: Choose which loan this belongs to.
errors.loanCurrency: That loan is in {currency} — use a {currency} account.

fx.vndSettled: Enter the VND amount actually settled.
fx.noDefaultRate: There is no default {currency} rate — enter the VND actually settled, or the rate.
